summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title) classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal, returning bool, with the required docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) for the title control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added section under Unreleased with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Tests were not run, per instructions, so verification is by reading only. Nothing committed.
